verdict.rationale: React docs confirm state changes trigger UI updates matching new data (react-docs-3) and that React efficiently diffs the DOM rather than re-rendering everything (react-comm-10), but the model works by re-running whole component functions on state change and reconciling via a virtual DOM, not by isolating re-execution to only the code that depends on the changed value (fine-grained reactivity like signals). Missing for 10: no evidence of dependency-tracked/fine-grained reactivity primitives, first-party docs explicitly contrasting re-render scope vs. dependent-code-only execution, and independent benchmarks confirming minimal re-render surface.
